description: Computes the due date of a statutory period for each of up to 50 recovery accounts, from an event and its date — the SARFAESI Act periods, the DRAT appeal period, and the cheque-dishonour notice, payment and complaint periods under the Negotiable Instruments Act — and returns them sorted by due date, flagged when due within 7 or 14 days. Use to build or check a deadline list across several accounts.

date.description: Date of the event, YYYY-MM-DD or DD-MM-YYYY

event.description: The event the period runs from: "s13-2" = Demand notice — time to discharge liability (SARFAESI Act Section 13(2)), running from the date of the demand notice; "s13-3a" = Creditor’s reply to the borrower’s representation (SARFAESI Act Section 13(3A)), running from receipt of the borrower’s representation or objection; "s14" = District Magistrate / CMM to pass a possession order (SARFAESI Act Section 14 (second proviso)), running from the date of the secured creditor’s application; "s17-1" = Securitisation application to the DRT (SARFAESI Act Section 17(1)), running from the date on which the measure was taken under Section 13(4); "s17-5" = DRT to dispose of the securitisation application (SARFAESI Act Section 17(5)), running from the date of the application; "s18-1" = Appeal to the DRAT (SARFAESI Act Section 18(1)), running from the date of receipt of the order of the Debts Recovery Tribunal; "drat_appeal_received_order" = Appeal to the DRAT (RDB Act s.20(3); SARFAESI Act s.18(1)), running from the date of receipt of the DRT order; "ni138_bank_intimation" = Demand notice to the drawer of the dishonoured cheque (NI Act s.138, proviso (b)), running from receipt of information from the bank that the cheque was returned unpaid; "ni138_notice_received" = Drawer’s time to pay after receiving the notice (NI Act s.138, proviso (c)), running from receipt of the notice by the drawer; "ni138_cause_of_action" = Complaint to the Magistrate (NI Act s.142(1)(b)), running from the date on which the cause of action arises under clause (c) of the proviso to s.138 — enter the day after the drawer’s fifteen-day period to pay expired without payment

ref.description: The user’s own label for the account or matter, e.g. "Loan 4471 — Sharma Traders"
